query:
SELECT 
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].title') as first_comp_title,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].revenue') as first_comp_revenue,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].id') as first_comp_id,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].imageUrl') as first_comp_image,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.selectedAmenities') as selected_amenities,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.amenityFilter') as amenity_filter
FROM universal_shareable_reports
WHERE shareCode = '2v9cjmVa9k';
